    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignUp_To_GenerateAccount" sourceRef="Task_SignUp" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateAccount_To_AssignAccess" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignAccess_To_TriggerBilling" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TriggerBilling_To_Ongoing" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Ongoing_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendEnhancements_To_SendRenewalNotice" sourceRef="Task_SendEnhancements" targetRef="Task_SendRenewalNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRenewalNotice_To_CancelSplit" sourceRef="Task_SendRenewalNotice" targetRef="Gateway_CancelRequest_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoCancel_To_Ongoing" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelRequest_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Ongoing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancel_To_SubmitCancel" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelRequest_Split" targetRef="Task_SubmitCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitCancel_To_ProcessCancel" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancel" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessCancel_To_TermsSplit" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancel" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplyRefund_To_TermsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplyCharge_To_TermsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Join"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Subscribe</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CancelRequest_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TriggerBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Ongoing_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRegularUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendEnhancements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRenewalNotifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Terms_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefunds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharges</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Terms_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Deactivate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Settle</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Subscribe">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_SignUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SignUp" name="Sign up and enter personal and payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_SignUp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SignUp_To_GenerateAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SignUp_To_GenerateAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateAccount_To_AssignAccess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateAccount_To_AssignAccess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssignAccess_To_TriggerBilling</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_TriggerBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycles">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssignAccess_To_TriggerBilling</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TriggerBilling_To_Ongoing</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Ongoing_Merge" name="Subscription ongoing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TriggerBilling_To_Ongoing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoCancel_To_Ongoing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ongoing_To_SendRegularUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRegularUpdates" name="Send regular updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ongoing_To_SendRegularUpdates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendRegularUpdates_To_SendEnhancements</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEnhancements" name="Send product enhancements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendRegularUpdates_To_SendEnhancements</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendEnhancements_To_SendRenewalNotifications</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRenewalNotifications" name="Send renewal notifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendEnhancements_To_SendRenewalNotifications</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendRenewalNotifications_To_CancelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CancelRequest_Split" name="Customer decides to cancel?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendRenewalNotifications_To_CancelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoCancel_To_Ongoing</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancel_To_SubmitCancel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitCancel" name="Submit cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancel_To_SubmitCancel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitCancel_To_ProcessCancel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancel" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitCancel_To_ProcessCancel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProcessCancel_To_TermsSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Terms_Split" name="Refund or charge due under terms?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProcessCancel_To_TermsSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refund_To_ApplyRefunds</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Charge_To_ApplyCharges</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApplyRefunds" name="Apply refunds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refund_To_ApplyRefunds</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApplyRefunds_To_TermsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApplyCharges" name="Apply charges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Charge_To_ApplyCharges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApplyCharges_To_TermsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Terms_Join" name="Refund or charge applied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApplyRefunds_To_TermsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApplyCharges_To_TermsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TermsJoin_To_Deactivate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Deactivate" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TermsJoin_To_Deactivate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deactivate_To_Settle</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Settle" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deactivate_To_Settle</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Settle_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription deactivated and balance settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Settle_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_SignUp" sourceRef="StartEvent_Subscribe" targetRef="Task_SignUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignUp_To_GenerateAccount" sourceRef="Task_SignUp" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateAccount_To_AssignAccess" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignAccess_To_TriggerBilling" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TriggerBilling_To_Ongoing" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Ongoing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ongoing_To_SendRegularUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_Ongoing_Merge" targetRef="Task_SendRegularUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRegularUpdates_To_SendEnhancements" sourceRef="Task_SendRegularUpdates" targetRef="Task_SendEnhancements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendEnhancements_To_SendRenewalNotifications" sourceRef="Task_SendEnhancements" targetRef="Task_SendRenewalNotifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendRenewalNotifications_To_CancelSplit" sourceRef="Task_SendRenewalNotifications" targetRef="Gateway_CancelRequest_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoCancel_To_Ongoing" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelRequest_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Ongoing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancel_To_SubmitCancel" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelRequest_Split" targetRef="Task_SubmitCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitCancel_To_ProcessCancel" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancel" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessCancel_To_TermsSplit" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancel" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_To_ApplyRefunds" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefunds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Charge_To_ApplyCharges" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplyRefunds_To_TermsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefunds" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplyCharges_To_TermsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharges" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsJoin_To_Deactivate" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Join" targetRef="Task_Deactivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deactivate_To_Settle" sourceRef="Task_Deactivate" targetRef="Task_Settle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Settle_To_End" sourceRef="Task_Settle" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins when a party performs an action of its own (for example, reporting something) and that action is followed by further described steps: Model a start event that carries no work, then a task performed by that party, named with the action the description gives for it. Connect that task by a sequence flow to the next described step. Do not make the party's action itself the start event, and do not drop the action from the model.
rules.situation: the description says the process begins when a party performs an action of its own (such as signing up or supplying information) and further described steps follow that action

rules.instruction: When The description names several separate kinds of items joined by commas and 'or' as the objects of one action that the process performs or sends, and each kind is described as a distinct action with its own outcome.: Model each named kind as its own task, labeled with the action and that kind's object as the description states them, in the order the description gives. Do not keep the full 'or' phrase in one task label. If the description ties the choice among kinds to a stated condition, place an exclusive gateway before the kind tasks, give each on its own outgoing flow, and merge the branches afterwards.
rules.situation: The description names several separate kinds of items joined by commas and 'or' as the objects of one action that the process performs or sends, and each kind is described as a distinct action with its own outcome.

rules.instruction: When the description states that the process is started by a participant performing an action of their own, such as submitting or entering information, and that the system then acts on that input: Keep the start event as the process trigger, and model the participant's performed action as a task (user task if it is a manual entry) placed after the start event and before the system tasks that process the input. Do not name the start event after that action or use the start event to stand for the action.
rules.situation: the description states that the process is started by a participant performing an action of their own, such as submitting or entering information, and that the system then acts on that input

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins when a participant performs an action (for example registering and providing personal or payment details) that is itself described as work done by that participant: Model the start as a plain start event with no label carrying the action, followed by a task (user task if the participant enters data in a system) that performs the described action. Do not label the start event with the action, because the performed work would then be lost from the flow.
rules.situation: the description says the process begins when a participant performs an action (for example registering and providing personal or payment details) that is itself described as work done by that participant

rules.instruction: When the description has several alternative paths that converge before a later optional decision, for example a recurring phase whose alternatives must all pass before a customer may choose an action: Model an exclusive merge gateway that joins the alternative paths before the decision gateway. Connect the merge to the decision by a sequence flow, so that the decision is reached once from whichever alternative path was taken.
rules.situation: the description has several alternative paths that converge before a later optional decision, for example a recurring phase whose alternatives must all pass before a customer may choose an action

rules.instruction: When the description attaches a dependency or condition clause (for example 'depending on the terms' or 'according to the agreement') to an action that the process performs: Label the task with the verb and object of the action as the description states them, and leave out the dependency clause from the label. If the clause makes the action conditional or alternative, model the choice with a gateway and conditional flows instead of appending the clause to the task name.
rules.situation: the description attaches a dependency or condition clause (for example 'depending on the terms' or 'according to the agreement') to an action that the process performs

promoted.trigger: the description states that the process begins with a participant performing an action that the description itself presents as work carried out by that participant
promoted.instruction: Model the start as an unlabeled start event followed by a task that performs the described action (a user task when the participant works through a system). Do not put the action into the start event label, since that would drop the performed work from the flow.
promoted.detail: general form of EXS-018, written after it improved the model of example 11
